# The Problem


The CRAN packages for Likert-type data workflow, viz, @mollazehi2025; @winzar2026 and @bryer2025, did not encompass transliteration to other formats for more robust interpretation, but, facilitates standard Likert items workflows. They work on conventional, clean ordinal format lacking the architectural framework for  transliteration.

Empirical workflow may encounter non-standard data requiring transformation, like converting Likert-type items into ordinal scales and vice versa, or synthesizing valid Likert-type scales from non-Likert data. The existing workflow cannot execute these transformations natively, therefore, efforts has to rely on disjointed, manual workarounds and ad-hoc scripting. This fragmentation disrupts analysis, introduces data entry risks and errors, resulting in man-hours' loss. This project proposes an open-source R package for transliteration and dynamic format conversion to fill the gap while preserving data integrity, and handling non-standard Likert-type natively.
